steps.label: 3077-own-disposable387-twin-family-readback
command: (async()=>{if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('itemId')!=='2089387')throw Error('Own disposable');const rows=await Promise.all(['/item/all/twins.donga?itemId=2089387','/item/all/twin-histories.donga?itemId=2089387'].map(async path=>{const r=await fetch(path,{credentials:'same-origin'});if(!r.ok||r.redirected)throw Error('Readback failed');if(path.includes('histories'))return {path,status:r.status,histories:await r.json()};const d=new DOMParser().parseFromString(await r.text(),'text/html');d.querySelectorAll('script,style,template').forEach(e=>e.remove());return {path,status:r.status,text:d.body.textContent.trim(),links:[...d.querySelectorAll('a[href]')].map(e=>({text:e.textContent.trim(),href:e.getAttribute('href')}))};}));return {rows};})()
